messages:
Mira: quick heads-up — after flipping the kv-sampler canary in staging we saw a noticeable p99 token-latency regression (12-15%) on our longctx synthetic workload when session stickiness was on. :eyes:
Sam: yikes. which sampler mode did you try? link to the run?
Mira: random_prefetch + eviction_bias=session_stickiness. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.dev/d/kv-sampler/canary-run-3478
Alec: can you paste a repro command? i'll run a tight job against the same binary.
Mira: repro (staging, 8xA100, longctx):
```
# staging repro
./perf_runner --workload longctx --concurrency 64 --duration 10m \ 
  --kv-sampler-mode random_prefetch --sample-rate 0.05 --session-sticky=true
```
Jay: quick diffs i ran: p50 ~no-change, p95 +6%, p99 +13%. resident pages increased ~8% during the run.
Sam: that memory bump screams prefetch thrash — sampler touching lots of pages and preventing eviction.
Alec: do we know which kernel path these requests took? fast-kv vs memcpy path matters: prefetch touches can force memcpy fallback and blow p99.
Mira: observed on fast-kv (A100). logs show extra copy ops around prefetch boundaries. snippet:
```
kv_prefetch: sample_id=0x7f3e, pages_touched=128, kernel=fast-kv, memcpy_fallback=true
kv_eviction: candidate_pages=64, skipped_due_to_lock=12
```
Sam: two quick hypotheses:
- sample_rate too high relative to request locality -> pollutes the hotset
- sample key granularity is too fine (per-token/full-session) -> prefetching many tiny pages instead of a few useful prefix-aligned pages
Alec: leaning to keying granularity. if sample_key uses full-session-hash we lose prefix reuse and prefetch becomes noisy.
Jay: i'll spin a new canary with sample_rate=0.01 and sample_key=prefix_hash (vs full-session). also adding a heuristic to prefer already-hot pages before firing prefetch.
Mira: please also add trace flags so we can correlate sampler decisions with kernel fallbacks (sample_id, sample_mode, sample_key_type, pages_prefetched, prefetch_latency_ms).
Sam: agreed. add memcpy_fallback boolean to traces too.
Deploy-bot: canary updated in staging: kv-sampler sample_rate=0.01, sample_key=prefix_hash at 2024-11-06T18:12:12Z
Jay: early numbers look better: p99 regression reduced to ~+3%, resident page bump down to ~2%. prefetch_latency_ms aligns with memcpy_fallback spikes.
Alec: solid. proposed short plan:
- keep canary with sample_rate=0.01 & prefix_hash for 24h
- instrument traces (sample_group, memcpy_fallback) and collect a kernel microbench for prefetch touch patterns
- add a threshold to only prefetch when predicted_reuse_score > 0.7 if problem persists
Mira: i'll create a regression alert that fires if canary p99 > +5% vs baseline and file a follow-up ticket with repro steps + snippets.
Sam: one more: can we gate sampler to only consider page_aligned prefixes (limit fragmentation)? add param prefetch_alignment: page_aligned|token_aligned.
Jay: adding prefetch_alignment param now; will test page_aligned mode.
Mira: thanks. i'll monitor the canary and post observations. :thumbsup:
